chunks: And, in detail, We relate to you from the news of the messengers that which We have made firm thereby your heart, and there has come to you the truth in this, and a reminder and a admonition for the believers.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of the stories of the prophets in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine wisdom behind recounting the narratives of the prophets, emphasizing that these stories serve to stabilize the Prophet's heart (Yuthabbitu bihi fu'adaka) against the fatigue of his mission. It underscores the dual function of these accounts as both a source of truth (Al-Haqq) and a spiritual admonition (Maw'idhah) specifically tailored for the believers to reinforce their faith and resilience.
